rationale: Static Python semantics: C() constructs an instance but performs no binary addition, so the class's __add__ method is not invoked. The class defines no explicit constructor, and construction does not call f; f is reachable only through the unused __add__ body. The visible subprocess.run call is therefore not reached, and the expected result is no findings. The subprocess import is the complete preamble required by this single eval cell.
